verdict.rationale: Video translation with voice and lip sync is a fair question for an AI video-generation product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents dubbing, language translation, voice cloning or lip sync. Related features such as Modify Video V2, facial-expression transfer and multi-modal Agents are adjacent capabilities, not video translation.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can translate a finished video into other languages with the voice and lip sync carried over
